külüġüd: külüg — a swift, outstanding horse; plural -üd [駿, plural] · also külüg 'hero, outstanding man' (Ming 傑), plural -üd, 'heroes' (noun + plural; Ming 傑每)
kürčü: kür- — to reach, arrive; converb -čü after r, 'arriving' (verb, converb) [到着]
seṅgüm-i: Seṅgüm — Senggum, a man's name; accusative -i, 'Senggum (object)' (personal name + case; Ming 人名行) [人名行]
aburaγ̇ad: abura- — to save, rescue (Ming 救); converb -γ̇ad, 'having saved' (verb, converb) [救了]
selte: selte — with, bringing along (word uncertain; read from the Ming 帶) [帶]
köġün-ü-ġen: köġün — son; genitive -ü + reflexive-possessive -ġen, 'of one's own son' (noun + case + reflexive-possessive) [子 自的行]
temüžin-e: Temüžin — Temüjin, a man's name; dative-locative -e, 'to Temüjin' (personal name + case) [人名 行] · also with Ming (人)名 行, 'to Temüjin'
odun: od- — to go; converb -un, 'going' (verb, converb; ending uncertain) [去]
baraγsan: bara- — to be finished, ruined (here transitive, 'to ruin'); past participle -γsan, 'one who has ruined' (verb, participle) [廢盡的] · also intransitive, 'one that has been ruined, gone to ruin' (Ming 了的, 了了的), of a people
orγo-ban: orγo — household (a variant of orγa); reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own household' (noun + reflexive-possessive) [人烟自的行]
ögtebe: ög- — to give; passive -te- (Ming 被) + past -be, 'was given' (verb, passive past) [被與了]
ambar: ambar — what, something (Ming 甚麽; sense uncertain; the word is not known elsewhere, and 'what' is the Ming's reading) [甚麽] · also 'how' (Ming 怎生)
elčin: elčin — envoy, messenger (noun; Ming 使臣) [使臣]
irerün: ire- — to come; converb -rün, 'coming, while coming' (verb, converb) [來的]
